name: Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa
header:
Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa
Italy · Mathematics PhD; Corso ordinario di II livello in Mathematics and Computer Science, alongside University of Pisa MSc
Mathematics
Curated European option; SNS ordinary second-level admission is a separate funded route alongside the University of Pisa MSc.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Ordinary II-level route requires adequate Italian and separate Pisa MSc enrollment; PhD is a different
competition.
• Four-year UChicago BA may be eligible for PhD under equivalence review; no automatic equivalence
assumed.
• No 2027 deadline or stipend projected from 2026 evidence.
• External board member Corti is based at Imperial. Emeritus Fulvio Ricci and visitors are not represented as
ordinary available resident supervisors.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Two distinct routes. PhD: any citizenship; the qualifying degree must permit doctoral entry in its home system,
normally a master's or equivalent degree of at least four years, subject to the committee's equivalence
assessment. Thus a four-year UChicago BA is potentially admissible, not automatically approved: obtain a
written eligibility ruling. Prior call required the qualifying degree within the preceding five years or by 31
October 2026, and barred holders of an Italian PhD or previous Italian doctoral scholarships. Ordinary II level:
bachelor's/equivalent for concurrent Pisa MSc; prior call required first qualifying degree on/after 1 November
2024 or by 31 December 2026, and restrictions on previous master's enrollment in the relevant Italian classes
or foreign equivalent. An undergraduate taking graduate classes is not necessarily a prior master's enrollee;
clarify if applicable. Adequate Italian is required for ordinary admission. F-1 status is not Italian study
authorization. [s2] [s3] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
PhD: resolve BA equivalence with phd@sns.it; prepare Europass CV, complete transcript, thesis/abstract,
project, publications, passport, and 1-2 referees; register in SNS's online platform and complete every section.
Ordinary II level: check degree-date/prior-enrollment conditions and Italian proficiency; independently arrange
University of Pisa MSc admission and non-EU Universitaly/visa steps; prepare for on-site analysis and
geometry/algebra written and oral examinations. The TOLC requirement for ordinary first-level undergraduate
entry is not the second-level graduate route. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact relevant SNS faculty for research fit and confirm 2027 availability. Admission does not require a
pre-agreed supervisor; the doctoral supervisor is normally chosen after consultation within the first-year
structure. Strongest directly relevant internal core: Vistoli (algebraic geometry/stacks) and Zannier
(Diophantine/arithmetic geometry). External board member Alessio Corti is at Imperial, not an ordinary
resident SNS appointment. A 2026 chair search in algebraic/arithmetic/complex geometry and number theory
does not establish a completed hire. [s10] [s15]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use SNS's online application linked from the relevant competition. Complete all sections, retain application
confirmation/identifier and check official published assessment/oral lists, which can count as formal notice
without a personal invitation. Foreign candidates' fiscal-code/residence-permit placeholders are explained in

the FAQ; follow live instructions rather than guessing. Ordinary II-level SNS admission and Pisa university
enrollment are independent administrative steps. [s3] [s4] [s6]
Cycle verification [Prior cycle]
2027 entry call not found as of 5 November 2026. All explicit dates and award amounts here come from the
2026-27 entry calls and are historical planning evidence, not fall-2027 deadlines. The live PhD second-session
display cannot be used to infer an additional mathematics opportunity. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s6]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Prior cycle]
Autumn 2027 dates not found. PRIOR PhD mathematics: 19 February 2026, 23:59 CET; six mathematics places.
Qualification shortlist by 11 March; oral tests from 17 March; results by 2 April; course starts 1 November 2026.
The displayed June second session concerned other science courses, not an established second mathematics
round. PRIOR ordinary II level: 30 July 2026, 14:00 Italian time; analysis written 26 August, 08:30;
geometry/algebra 27 August, 08:30 (each six hours); oral examinations from 7 September, 09:00, individual
calendar published; final rankings not before 16 September. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s6]
Funding consideration [Prior cycle]
Funding is attached to winning admission, so the academic competition deadline also governs the ordinary SNS
award. Autumn 2027 dates and amounts unannounced. Prior ordinary travel/lodging reimbursement requests
due 31 October 2026; prior PhD interview travel reimbursement requests due 16 November 2026. These
expense deadlines are not application deadlines. [s2] [s6]
Reference receipt [Prior cycle]
PhD: referees have one week after application closure; prior mathematics deadline therefore 26 February
2026, 23:59 CET. Minimum one letter must arrive; no assumption that late letters will be accepted. Ordinary II
level: no recommendation letters specified in the exam-based call. 2027 PhD date unknown. [s2]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
No GRE or TOEFL/IELTS score-submission deadline established. Ordinary II-level admission instead uses SNS
written/oral exams and assesses Italian knowledge. Prior examination dates are in application-deadline field;
future schedule awaits call. [s2] [s6]
Supporting documents [Prior cycle]
PhD application attachments by competition deadline; recommendation exception one week later. Prior PhD
qualifying degree by 31 October 2026; admitted foreign-degree students supply legalised/translated
qualifications and Declaration of Value or CIMEA comparability at enrollment, by individual office instructions.
Ordinary application by competition deadline, degree by 31 December 2026 under the prior call; winner's
university-enrollment declaration, photo, and other evidence due by dates individually communicated. SNS
ordinary accepts English-language qualification certificates without Italian translation; Pisa's separate
registration rules must also be met. [s2] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
No general April 15 commitment rule. PhD acceptance deadline is set in the individual SNS communication;
failure to accept or report at the start loses the place. Ordinary winners must report on the date in their
nomination and return required documents by the communicated deadline; unfilled places may be reassigned
within 30 days of course start. Exact 2027 acceptance dates unannounced. [s2] [s6]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
PhD application asks for self-assessment of Italian/English using CEFR; mathematics admission tests may be in
Italian or English. No mandatory TOEFL/IELTS certificate or numerical minimum identified in the legal call;
Italian courses are offered to admitted non-Italian doctoral students. Ordinary II-level admission requires
sufficient Italian to participate; examinations can use Italian/English and Italian competence can be assessed
orally. Do not treat an English-speaking PhD route as evidence that the concurrent ordinary/MSc route is
English-only. [s2] [s4] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No UChicago-specific waiver application established, because the inspected PhD call does not require a
standardized English score. UChicago study does not remove ordinary-route Italian requirements or University
of Pisa's separate language requirements. [s2] [s6]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Neither GRE General nor GRE Mathematics is listed as required in the inspected SNS PhD or ordinary
competition documents. This is absence from a complete requirements list, not an explicit statement that
unsolicited scores are accepted or considered. Prioritize SNS's own examinations and required dossier. [s2] [s6]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]

upload English certifications with institution, degree, completion date and results, or an institution-issued

alternative; US degrees do not use the EHEA-only Diploma Supplement simplification. Ordinary: declare
degrees and prior university/master's enrollment; provide supporting foreign qualification certificates when
required after nomination, with English accepted by SNS. Pisa has a separate recognition/enrollment file. [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
PhD: at least one and at most two scholarly recommendation letters, confidentially submitted through the
online procedure. Ordinary II-level competition: none specified; selection uses examinations. [s2]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No additional recommendation is specified for the standard SNS funded place. Topic-specific doctoral awards
may require a separate project, not a separately established letter count. Ordinary stipend/residence benefits
follow admission; external awards have their own rules. [s2] [s6]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
PhD referee details are supplied to the SNS platform, which requests the confidential letters electronically. The

public call does not clearly distinguish immediate invitation on saving details from invitation on final
submission; verify in the live 2027 portal before relying on early invitations. Ordinary: not applicable. [s2] [s4]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
Whether invitations are exclusively post-submission is not established publicly. Do not delay the PhD
application on the assumption referees are already invited; confirm dispatch with each referee and the office.
Ordinary: no letters. [s2] [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
The platform guide describes completion/submission indicators for the application; it does not establish an
applicant-visible confidential-reference receipt dashboard. Confirm directly in the live portal or with
phd@sns.it. Ordinary: no letters. [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Public instructions do not establish referee replacement, post-submission letter updates, or reuse between SNS
programs/cycles. Obtain office guidance; a separate application is needed for each doctoral course and
required materials can differ. [s2] [s4]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
PhD: curriculum vitae in Europass format, PDF attachment; no separate page/word/font limit specified.
Ordinary II level: no CV requirement identified in the call's exam-based application. [s2] [s6]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No standalone PhD statement-of-purpose prompt identified. Motivation, preparation and plans belong in the
required research project/CV and oral assessment. Ordinary: no separate SOP listed. [s2] [s6]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background/diversity statement listed for either SNS route in inspected calls. Do not
import US essay requirements. [s2] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
PhD interests are expressed in the research project and its English abstract; no separate interest statement
identified. Ordinary II level: no research-interest essay listed. [s2] [s6]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
PhD required project: approximately/up to 20,000 characters including spaces, with English abstract
approximately 3,000 characters. Describe proposed work, state of the art, methods, bibliography and
relevance to SNS; upload PDF in Italian or English, with the required English abstract. The project demonstrates
research aptitude and is not binding on eventual thesis choice. Submit a distinct project for each PhD course;
optional additional projects for specific-topic scholarships. The English call presents the character limit more
strictly than the Italian indicative wording: stay within it. Ordinary: none listed. [s2] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
PhD: complete thesis plus English abstract about 15,000 characters including spaces. If thesis unfinished, or
written in a language other than Italian/English, provide an extended abstract in Italian or English about 25,000
characters. The FAQ's general 25,000-character advice is less differentiated than the legal call; use the
route-specific call requirement. PDF upload, not merely a link. Ordinary: no thesis/writing sample listed. [s2] [s3]
Publications list [Standing rule]
PhD: copies of any publications are among dossier attachments, uploaded as PDFs. A standalone
publications-list template is not specified; list publications in the CV as appropriate but do not substitute links
for requested copies. No publication prerequisite is stated. Ordinary: none listed. [s2] [s6]

Course-list document [Standing rule]
No separate authored mathematics-course statement mandated by SNS; supply the academic records
described above. Ordinary eligibility assessment can require study-plan declarations. [s2] [s6]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Standard SNS award requires no separate scholarship essay. Additional projects can be supplied for PhD
topic-specific awards; ordinary means-tested contribution requires ISEE/equivalent economic documentation,
not an essay. Future special awards may impose their own forms. [s2] [s6]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
PhD: identity document, application declarations and CEFR language self-assessment; all attachments PDF and
Italian/English or translated. Publicly verified general font, margin and file-size requirements not found.
Ordinary: online identity/citizenship/contact/degree and previous-enrollment declarations; completed
submission gives confirmation and prematricola identifier. No general essay packet listed. [s2] [s4] [s6]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
PRIOR 2026-27 PhD: €18,848 gross annually, including lodging allowance, in 12 deferred monthly instalments;
free board except academic vacations. Residence access uses the lodging allowance, so it is not an additional
unconditional free-housing award. Ordinary II level: free SNS residence/meals, subject to housing availability
and academic vacations; if no SNS room, alternative accommodation or €460/month housing contribution for
2026-27. Additional annual all-inclusive teaching contribution depends on ISEE: ≤€40,000: €5,000;
€40,001-45,000: €4,500; 45,001-50,000: €4,000; 50,001-55,000: €3,500; 55,001-60,000: €3,000;
60,001-65,000: €2,000; 65,001-70,000: €1,000; above €70,000 or no ISEE: €500. This includes full/partial
reimbursement of Pisa university charges; it is not necessarily cash entirely available after tuition. 2027-28
values unpublished. [s2] [s6]
Years of support [Standing rule]
PhD mathematics is four years, with study/progression obligations. Ordinary II-level route accompanies the
two-year MSc and requires annual promotion; funding is not guaranteed through an eventual PhD without a
separate successful doctoral competition. [s2] [s6] [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Both competitions admit all citizenships and standard awards are available to international winners. Prior PhD
calls reserve a place per course for qualifying foreign-university graduates under call conditions. Non-EU
winners can request documented arrival-travel reimbursement up to €1,000; PhD graduates can request
return-home reimbursement up to €1,000 within a year of defence, with additional conditions for early
departure. Ordinary ISEE-sensitive funding requires economic evidence; an international student should not
assume the maximum €5,000. [s2] [s6]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PhD payments depend on study obligations and INPS social-security registration; gross figures are not
take-home. Ordinary students reside locally and follow both Pisa and SNS programs; every internal/university
exam must be ≥24/30 and the average ≥27/30 for progression. External commitments cannot conflict with
study. PhD regional DSU tax is reimbursed if actually due and paid, after following
exemption/economic-documentation procedures; not an unconditional waiver without paperwork. [s2] [s6] [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate standard scholarship competition after admission. Ordinary higher teaching contribution requires
ISEE/economic documentation; request office instructions for foreign family income/assets. Relocation,
interview expenses and authorised research travel require separate claims and receipts. Special doctoral-topic
projects require separate identification in the application where applicable. [s2] [s6]

Other funding routes [Prior cycle]
PhD SNS supports authorised research/study visits in Italy and abroad in addition to the stipend. Prior
interview-travel reimbursement: residents abroad maximum €700 with €50 excess and permitted travel types;
claim deadline 16 November 2026. Ordinary entrance-test travel/lodging support is means-tested (ISEE below
€35,000), with separate forms and caps; housing request must precede application close and reimbursement
requests by 31 October 2026. Pisa/INdAM/DSU awards may exist independently; verify compatibility rather
than stacking them automatically. [s2] [s6]
Application fee [Unresolved]
SNS study/enrollment is free for successful students. PhD regional DSU tax may be payable initially and
reimbursed through the specified process. A separate competition application fee was not established in the
inspected sources; do not label it €0 solely from free attendance. University of Pisa MSc fees and recognition
costs are separate for ordinary II-level entrants. [s2] [s6]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No verified SNS application-fee waiver procedure because an application fee itself was not established. PhD
DSU regional-tax exemption/reimbursement and ordinary contribution toward Pisa fees are distinct
mechanisms. Foreign-degree comparability/translation and visa costs are not automatically waived. [s2] [s6]

Ordinary II level: free SNS residence/meals, subject to housing availability and academic vacations; if no SNS room, alternative accommodation or €460/month housing contribution for 2026-27. Additional annual all-inclusive teaching contribution depends on ISEE: ≤€40,000: €5,000; €40,001-45,000: €4,500; 45,001-50,000: €4,000; 50,001-55,000: €3,500; 55,001-60,000: €3,000; 60,001-65,000: €2,000; 65,001-70,000: €1,000; above €70,000 or no ISEE: €500. This includes full/partial reimbursement of Pisa university charges; it is not necessarily cash entirely available after tuition. 2027-28 values unpublished. [s2] [s6]

fields.label: Years of support
fields.text: PhD mathematics is four years, with study/progression obligations. Ordinary II-level route accompanies the two-year MSc and requires annual promotion; funding is not guaranteed through an eventual PhD without a separate successful doctoral competition. [s2] [s6] [s9]

fields.label: International eligibility
fields.text: Both competitions admit all citizenships and standard awards are available to international winners. Prior PhD calls reserve a place per course for qualifying foreign-university graduates under call conditions. Non-EU winners can request documented arrival-travel reimbursement up to €1,000; PhD graduates can request return-home reimbursement up to €1,000 within a year of defence, with additional conditions for early departure. Ordinary ISEE-sensitive funding requires economic evidence; an international student should not assume the maximum €5,000. [s2] [s6]

fields.label: Conditions and duties
fields.text: PhD payments depend on study obligations and INPS social-security registration; gross figures are not take-home. Ordinary students reside locally and follow both Pisa and SNS programs; every internal/university exam must be ≥24/30 and the average ≥27/30 for progression. External commitments cannot conflict with study. PhD regional DSU tax is reimbursed if actually due and paid, after following exemption/economic-documentation procedures; not an unconditional waiver without paperwork. [s2] [s6] [s9]

fields.label: Extra funding application
fields.text: No separate standard scholarship competition after admission. Ordinary higher teaching contribution requires ISEE/economic documentation; request office instructions for foreign family income/assets. Relocation, interview expenses and authorised research travel require separate claims and receipts. Special doctoral-topic projects require separate identification in the application where applicable. [s2] [s6]

fields.label: Other funding routes
fields.text: PhD SNS supports authorised research/study visits in Italy and abroad in addition to the stipend. Prior interview-travel reimbursement: residents abroad maximum €700 with €50 excess and permitted travel types; claim deadline 16 November 2026. Ordinary entrance-test travel/lodging support is means-tested (ISEE below €35,000), with separate forms and caps; housing request must precede application close and reimbursement requests by 31 October 2026. Pisa/INdAM/DSU awards may exist independently; verify compatibility rather than stacking them automatically. [s2] [s6]

fields.label: Application fee
fields.text: SNS study/enrollment is free for successful students. PhD regional DSU tax may be payable initially and reimbursed through the specified process. A separate competition application fee was not established in the inspected sources; do not label it €0 solely from free attendance. University of Pisa MSc fees and recognition costs are separate for ordinary II-level entrants. [s2] [s6]

fields.label: Fee waiver
fields.text: No verified SNS application-fee waiver procedure because an application fee itself was not established. PhD DSU regional-tax exemption/reimbursement and ordinary contribution toward Pisa fees are distinct mechanisms. Foreign-degree comparability/translation and visa costs are not automatically waived. Italy · Mathematics PhD; Corso ordinario di II livello in Mathematics and Computer Science, alongside University of Pisa MSc
Mathematics
Curated European option; SNS ordinary second-level admission is a separate funded route alongside the University of Pisa MSc.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Ordinary II-level route requires adequate Italian and separate Pisa MSc enrollment; PhD is a different
competition.
• Four-year UChicago BA may be eligible for PhD under equivalence review; no automatic equivalence
assumed.
• No 2027 deadline or stipend projected from 2026 evidence.
• External board member Corti is based at Imperial. Emeritus Fulvio Ricci and visitors are not represented as
ordinary available resident supervisors.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Two distinct routes. PhD: any citizenship; the qualifying degree must permit doctoral entry in its home system,
normally a master's or equivalent degree of at least four years, subject to the committee's equivalence
assessment. Thus a four-year UChicago BA is potentially admissible, not automatically approved: obtain a
written eligibility ruling. Prior call required the qualifying degree within the preceding five years or by 31
October 2026, and barred holders of an Italian PhD or previous Italian doctoral scholarships. Ordinary II level:
bachelor's/equivalent for concurrent Pisa MSc; prior call required first qualifying degree on/after 1 November
2024 or by 31 December 2026, and restrictions on previous master's enrollment in the relevant Italian classes
or foreign equivalent. An undergraduate taking graduate classes is not necessarily a prior master's enrollee;
clarify if applicable. Adequate Italian is required for ordinary admission. F-1 status is not Italian study
authorization. [s2] [s3] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
PhD: resolve BA equivalence with phd@sns.it; prepare Europass CV, complete transcript, thesis/abstract,
project, publications, passport, and 1-2 referees; register in SNS's online platform and complete every section.
Ordinary II level: check degree-date/prior-enrollment conditions and Italian proficiency; independently arrange
University of Pisa MSc admission and non-EU Universitaly/visa steps; prepare for on-site analysis and
geometry/algebra written and oral examinations. The TOLC requirement for ordinary first-level undergraduate
entry is not the second-level graduate route. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact relevant SNS faculty for research fit and confirm 2027 availability. Admission does not require a
pre-agreed supervisor; the doctoral supervisor is normally chosen after consultation within the first-year
structure. Strongest directly relevant internal core: Vistoli (algebraic geometry/stacks) and Zannier
(Diophantine/arithmetic geometry). External board member Alessio Corti is at Imperial, not an ordinary
resident SNS appointment. A 2026 chair search in algebraic/arithmetic/complex geometry and number theory
does not establish a completed hire. [s10] [s15]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use SNS's online application linked from the relevant competition. Complete all sections, retain application
confirmation/identifier and check official published assessment/oral lists, which can count as formal notice
without a personal invitation. Foreign candidates' fiscal-code/residence-permit placeholders are explained in

PhD application attachments by competition deadline; recommendation exception one week later. Prior PhD

GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]

PhD: Diploma Supplement or equivalent complete qualification/exam documentation; non-EU graduates may

degrees and prior university/master's enrollment; provide supporting foreign qualification certificates when

Number and type [Standing rule]
PhD: at least one and at most two scholarly recommendation letters, confidentially submitted through the

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
PRIOR 2026-27 PhD: €18,848 gross annually, including lodging allowance, in 12 deferred monthly instalments;
free board except academic vacations. Residence access uses the lodging allowance, so it is not an additional
unconditional free-housing award. Ordinary II level: free SNS residence/meals, subject to housing availability
and academic vacations; if no SNS room, alternative accommodation or €460/month housing contribution for
2026-27. Additional annual all-inclusive teaching contribution depends on ISEE: ≤€40,000: €5,000;
€40,001-45,000: €4,500; 45,001-50,000: €4,000; 50,001-55,000: €3,500; 55,001-60,000: €3,000;
60,001-65,000: €2,000; 65,001-70,000: €1,000; above €70,000 or no ISEE: €500. This includes full/partial
reimbursement of Pisa university charges; it is not necessarily cash entirely available after tuition. 2027-28

PhD mathematics is four years, with study/progression obligations. Ordinary II-level route accompanies the

International eligibility [Standing rule]

Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa
Italy · Mathematics PhD; Corso ordinario di II livello in Mathematics and Computer Science, alongside University of Pisa MSc
Mathematics
Curated European option; SNS ordinary second-level admission is a separate funded route alongside the University of Pisa MSc.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Ordinary II-level route requires adequate Italian and separate Pisa MSc enrollment; PhD is a different
competition.
• Four-year UChicago BA may be eligible for PhD under equivalence review; no automatic equivalence
assumed.
• No 2027 deadline or stipend projected from 2026 evidence.
• External board member Corti is based at Imperial. Emeritus Fulvio Ricci and visitors are not represented as
ordinary available resident supervisors.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Two distinct routes. PhD: any citizenship; the qualifying degree must permit doctoral entry in its home system,
normally a master's or equivalent degree of at least four years, subject to the committee's equivalence
assessment. Thus a four-year UChicago BA is potentially admissible, not automatically approved: obtain a
written eligibility ruling. Prior call required the qualifying degree within the preceding five years or by 31
October 2026, and barred holders of an Italian PhD or previous Italian doctoral scholarships. Ordinary II level:
bachelor's/equivalent for concurrent Pisa MSc; prior call required first qualifying degree on/after 1 November
2024 or by 31 December 2026, and restrictions on previous master's enrollment in the relevant Italian classes
or foreign equivalent. An undergraduate taking graduate classes is not necessarily a prior master's enrollee;
clarify if applicable. Adequate Italian is required for ordinary admission. F-1 status is not Italian study
authorization. [s2] [s3] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
PhD: resolve BA equivalence with phd@sns.it; prepare Europass CV, complete transcript, thesis/abstract,
project, publications, passport, and 1-2 referees; register in SNS's online platform and complete every section.
Ordinary II level: check degree-date/prior-enrollment conditions and Italian proficiency; independently arrange
University of Pisa MSc admission and non-EU Universitaly/visa steps; prepare for on-site analysis and
geometry/algebra written and oral examinations. The TOLC requirement for ordinary first-level undergraduate
entry is not the second-level graduate route. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact relevant SNS faculty for research fit and confirm 2027 availability. Admission does not require a
pre-agreed supervisor; the doctoral supervisor is normally chosen after consultation within the first-year
structure. Strongest directly relevant internal core: Vistoli (algebraic geometry/stacks) and Zannier
(Diophantine/arithmetic geometry). External board member Alessio Corti is at Imperial, not an ordinary
resident SNS appointment. A 2026 chair search in algebraic/arithmetic/complex geometry and number theory
does not establish a completed hire. [s10] [s15]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use SNS's online application linked from the relevant competition. Complete all sections, retain application
confirmation/identifier and check official published assessment/oral lists, which can count as formal notice
without a personal invitation. Foreign candidates' fiscal-code/residence-permit placeholders are explained in

the FAQ; follow live instructions rather than guessing. Ordinary II-level SNS admission and Pisa university
enrollment are independent administrative steps. [s3] [s4] [s6]
Cycle verification [Prior cycle]
2027 entry call not found as of 5 November 2026. All explicit dates and award amounts here come from the
2026-27 entry calls and are historical planning evidence, not fall-2027 deadlines. The live PhD second-session
display cannot be used to infer an additional mathematics opportunity. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s6]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Prior cycle]
Autumn 2027 dates not found. PRIOR PhD mathematics: 19 February 2026, 23:59 CET; six mathematics places.
Qualification shortlist by 11 March; oral tests from 17 March; results by 2 April; course starts 1 November 2026.
The displayed June second session concerned other science courses, not an established second mathematics
round. PRIOR ordinary II level: 30 July 2026, 14:00 Italian time; analysis written 26 August, 08:30;
geometry/algebra 27 August, 08:30 (each six hours); oral examinations from 7 September, 09:00, individual
calendar published; final rankings not before 16 September. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s6]
Funding consideration [Prior cycle]
Funding is attached to winning admission, so the academic competition deadline also governs the ordinary SNS
award. Autumn 2027 dates and amounts unannounced. Prior ordinary travel/lodging reimbursement requests
due 31 October 2026; prior PhD interview travel reimbursement requests due 16 November 2026. These
expense deadlines are not application deadlines. [s2] [s6]
Reference receipt [Prior cycle]
PhD: referees have one week after application closure; prior mathematics deadline therefore 26 February
2026, 23:59 CET. Minimum one letter must arrive; no assumption that late letters will be accepted. Ordinary II
level: no recommendation letters specified in the exam-based call. 2027 PhD date unknown. [s2]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
No GRE or TOEFL/IELTS score-submission deadline established. Ordinary II-level admission instead uses SNS
written/oral exams and assesses Italian knowledge. Prior examination dates are in application-deadline field;
future schedule awaits call. [s2] [s6]
Supporting documents [Prior cycle]
PhD application attachments by competition deadline; recommendation exception one week later. Prior PhD
qualifying degree by 31 October 2026; admitted foreign-degree students supply legalised/translated
qualifications and Declaration of Value or CIMEA comparability at enrollment, by individual office instructions.
Ordinary application by competition deadline, degree by 31 December 2026 under the prior call; winner's
university-enrollment declaration, photo, and other evidence due by dates individually communicated. SNS
ordinary accepts English-language qualification certificates without Italian translation; Pisa's separate
registration rules must also be met. [s2] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
No general April 15 commitment rule. PhD acceptance deadline is set in the individual SNS communication;
failure to accept or report at the start loses the place. Ordinary winners must report on the date in their
nomination and return required documents by the communicated deadline; unfilled places may be reassigned
within 30 days of course start. Exact 2027 acceptance dates unannounced. [s2] [s6]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
PhD application asks for self-assessment of Italian/English using CEFR; mathematics admission tests may be in
Italian or English. No mandatory TOEFL/IELTS certificate or numerical minimum identified in the legal call;
Italian courses are offered to admitted non-Italian doctoral students. Ordinary II-level admission requires
sufficient Italian to participate; examinations can use Italian/English and Italian competence can be assessed
orally. Do not treat an English-speaking PhD route as evidence that the concurrent ordinary/MSc route is
English-only. [s2] [s4] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No UChicago-specific waiver application established, because the inspected PhD call does not require a
standardized English score. UChicago study does not remove ordinary-route Italian requirements or University
of Pisa's separate language requirements. [s2] [s6]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Neither GRE General nor GRE Mathematics is listed as required in the inspected SNS PhD or ordinary
competition documents. This is absence from a complete requirements list, not an explicit statement that
unsolicited scores are accepted or considered. Prioritize SNS's own examinations and required dossier. [s2] [s6]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
PhD: Diploma Supplement or equivalent complete qualification/exam documentation; non-EU graduates may
upload English certifications with institution, degree, completion date and results, or an institution-issued
English transcript while awaiting graduation. Submit all examinations and marks, not only mathematics. On
admission a US qualification requires the call's translation/legalisation and Declaration of Value or CIMEA
alternative; US degrees do not use the EHEA-only Diploma Supplement simplification. Ordinary: declare
degrees and prior university/master's enrollment; provide supporting foreign qualification certificates when
required after nomination, with English accepted by SNS. Pisa has a separate recognition/enrollment file. [s2]
[s3] [s6]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
PhD transcript/Diploma Supplement must show examinations and results; no separate custom
mathematics-course list specified. Ordinary application asks for relevant enrollment/study-plan information,
particularly foreign prior master's study. Pisa admission may independently require detailed syllabi. [s2] [s3] [s6]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate course-description upload established for SNS PhD. Ordinary applicants with foreign prior graduate
study should provide the study-plan information required for eligibility assessment; the precise syllabus format
is not publicly fixed. University of Pisa recognition is a separate process. [s2] [s6]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
PhD: at least one and at most two scholarly recommendation letters, confidentially submitted through the
online procedure. Ordinary II-level competition: none specified; selection uses examinations. [s2]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No additional recommendation is specified for the standard SNS funded place. Topic-specific doctoral awards
may require a separate project, not a separately established letter count. Ordinary stipend/residence benefits
follow admission; external awards have their own rules. [s2] [s6]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
PhD referee details are supplied to the SNS platform, which requests the confidential letters electronically. The

public call does not clearly distinguish immediate invitation on saving details from invitation on final
submission; verify in the live 2027 portal before relying on early invitations. Ordinary: not applicable. [s2] [s4]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
Whether invitations are exclusively post-submission is not established publicly. Do not delay the PhD
application on the assumption referees are already invited; confirm dispatch with each referee and the office.
Ordinary: no letters. [s2] [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
The platform guide describes completion/submission indicators for the application; it does not establish an
applicant-visible confidential-reference receipt dashboard. Confirm directly in the live portal or with
phd@sns.it. Ordinary: no letters. [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Public instructions do not establish referee replacement, post-submission letter updates, or reuse between SNS
programs/cycles. Obtain office guidance; a separate application is needed for each doctoral course and
required materials can differ. [s2] [s4]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
PhD: curriculum vitae in Europass format, PDF attachment; no separate page/word/font limit specified.
Ordinary II level: no CV requirement identified in the call's exam-based application. [s2] [s6]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No standalone PhD statement-of-purpose prompt identified. Motivation, preparation and plans belong in the
required research project/CV and oral assessment. Ordinary: no separate SOP listed. [s2] [s6]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background/diversity statement listed for either SNS route in inspected calls. Do not
import US essay requirements. [s2] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
PhD interests are expressed in the research project and its English abstract; no separate interest statement
identified. Ordinary II level: no research-interest essay listed. [s2] [s6]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
PhD required project: approximately/up to 20,000 characters including spaces, with English abstract
approximately 3,000 characters. Describe proposed work, state of the art, methods, bibliography and
relevance to SNS; upload PDF in Italian or English, with the required English abstract. The project demonstrates
research aptitude and is not binding on eventual thesis choice. Submit a distinct project for each PhD course;
optional additional projects for specific-topic scholarships. The English call presents the character limit more
strictly than the Italian indicative wording: stay within it. Ordinary: none listed. [s2] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
PhD: complete thesis plus English abstract about 15,000 characters including spaces. If thesis unfinished, or
written in a language other than Italian/English, provide an extended abstract in Italian or English about 25,000
characters. The FAQ's general 25,000-character advice is less differentiated than the legal call; use the
route-specific call requirement. PDF upload, not merely a link. Ordinary: no thesis/writing sample listed. [s2] [s3]
Publications list [Standing rule]
PhD: copies of any publications are among dossier attachments, uploaded as PDFs. A standalone
publications-list template is not specified; list publications in the CV as appropriate but do not substitute links
for requested copies. No publication prerequisite is stated. Ordinary: none listed. [s2] [s6]

Course-list document [Standing rule]
No separate authored mathematics-course statement mandated by SNS; supply the academic records
described above. Ordinary eligibility assessment can require study-plan declarations. [s2] [s6]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Standard SNS award requires no separate scholarship essay. Additional projects can be supplied for PhD
topic-specific awards; ordinary means-tested contribution requires ISEE/equivalent economic documentation,
not an essay. Future special awards may impose their own forms. [s2] [s6]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
PhD: identity document, application declarations and CEFR language self-assessment; all attachments PDF and
Italian/English or translated. Publicly verified general font, margin and file-size requirements not found.
Ordinary: online identity/citizenship/contact/degree and previous-enrollment declarations; completed
submission gives confirmation and prematricola identifier. No general essay packet listed. [s2] [s4] [s6]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
PRIOR 2026-27 PhD: €18,848 gross annually, including lodging allowance, in 12 deferred monthly instalments;
free board except academic vacations. Residence access uses the lodging allowance, so it is not an additional
unconditional free-housing award. Ordinary II level: free SNS residence/meals, subject to housing availability
and academic vacations; if no SNS room, alternative accommodation or €460/month housing contribution for
2026-27. Additional annual all-inclusive teaching contribution depends on ISEE: ≤€40,000: €5,000;
€40,001-45,000: €4,500; 45,001-50,000: €4,000; 50,001-55,000: €3,500; 55,001-60,000: €3,000;
60,001-65,000: €2,000; 65,001-70,000: €1,000; above €70,000 or no ISEE: €500. This includes full/partial
reimbursement of Pisa university charges; it is not necessarily cash entirely available after tuition. 2027-28
values unpublished. [s2] [s6]
Years of support [Standing rule]
PhD mathematics is four years, with study/progression obligations. Ordinary II-level route accompanies the
two-year MSc and requires annual promotion; funding is not guaranteed through an eventual PhD without a
separate successful doctoral competition. [s2] [s6] [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Both competitions admit all citizenships and standard awards are available to international winners. Prior PhD
calls reserve a place per course for qualifying foreign-university graduates under call conditions. Non-EU
winners can request documented arrival-travel reimbursement up to €1,000; PhD graduates can request
return-home reimbursement up to €1,000 within a year of defence, with additional conditions for early
departure. Ordinary ISEE-sensitive funding requires economic evidence; an international student should not
assume the maximum €5,000. [s2] [s6]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PhD payments depend on study obligations and INPS social-security registration; gross figures are not
take-home. Ordinary students reside locally and follow both Pisa and SNS programs; every internal/university
exam must be ≥24/30 and the average ≥27/30 for progression. External commitments cannot conflict with
study. PhD regional DSU tax is reimbursed if actually due and paid, after following
exemption/economic-documentation procedures; not an unconditional waiver without paperwork. [s2] [s6] [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate standard scholarship competition after admission. Ordinary higher teaching contribution requires
ISEE/economic documentation; request office instructions for foreign family income/assets. Relocation,
interview expenses and authorised research travel require separate claims and receipts. Special doctoral-topic
projects require separate identification in the application where applicable. [s2] [s6]

Other funding routes [Prior cycle]
PhD SNS supports authorised research/study visits in Italy and abroad in addition to the stipend. Prior
interview-travel reimbursement: residents abroad maximum €700 with €50 excess and permitted travel types;
claim deadline 16 November 2026. Ordinary entrance-test travel/lodging support is means-tested (ISEE below
€35,000), with separate forms and caps; housing request must precede application close and reimbursement
requests by 31 October 2026. Pisa/INdAM/DSU awards may exist independently; verify compatibility rather
than stacking them automatically. [s2] [s6]
Application fee [Unresolved]

reimbursed through the specified process. A separate competition application fee was not established in the

costs are separate for ordinary II-level entrants. [s2] [s6]
